subject: Customer handoff: Cardinal.ai — success owners & kickoff plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@cardinal.ai>, procurement@cardinal.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Customer handoff: Cardinal.ai — success owners & kickoff plan

Team —

Quick handoff for Cardinal.ai (DEAL-9082). Won the deal last week; official start date on the PO is Aug 16. High-level context:
- Use case: integrate Redwood Hosted API for internal assistant (high throughput embeddings + chat). Primary concern for customer: predictable latency at scale and data governance controls.
- Committed capacity: 4 dedicated GPUs (monthly reserved pool) with burst to hosted as needed.
- Commercials: 12-month term; order-form attached (order-form-45321-signed.pdf).

Recommended owners: Monica to be primary CS lead for kickoff and onboarding; Grace to be escalation/ops partner for infra readiness; Karthik to be technical onboarding SME for the first two sprints.

Key milestones (customer expectations):
1) Kickoff meeting week of Aug 2 — internal prep prior to customer kickoff.
2) Staging integration: Aug 9 — 30% functional scope for smoke tests.
3) Go-live target: Aug 16 (customer has internal go/no-go on Aug 14).

Open/risk items:
- Security questionnaire (they requested SOC2 artifacts and network allowlist). I included procurement in CC.
- They asked for IP allowlist ranges and retention defaults; see questions from Emily in the thread.
- SOW v3 is attached (SOW_Cardinal_v3.pdf) — please confirm any redlines.

Asks:
- Monica: lead kickoff scheduling and confirm internal pre-kick meeting (30–45m) with engineering and infra.
- Grace: identify required infra owners and confirm expected maintenance windows for the dedicated pool.
- Karthik: prepare an integration checklist (sample SDK flows, expected traffic profiles, test prompts).

I will drop the HubSpot deal link below and hand the customer over by EOD.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: SOW_Cardinal_v3.pdf (application/pdf); pricing-summary-cardinal.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet); order-form-45321-signed.pdf (application/pdf)

Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Customer handoff: Cardinal.ai — success owners & kickoff plan

Thanks Ben — great context and congrats team.

Monica / Karthik — I can take point on infra readiness and escalation procedures. Quick asks from infra/security side before kickoff:
- Can we get the customer security contact? (Emily, can you introduce your security/compliance lead?)
- We need the list of public IP ranges they can source requests from (for allowlist) and confirm whether they expect mutual TLS or token-only auth for staging.
- Any special data retention / redaction requirements beyond our default 30-day KV cache?

I'll slot time for an internal 30m sync tomorrow to map owners and confirm what we need for the staging environment.

On the SOW: I glanced at v3 and there are two minor misc items (metrics SLA language and acceptance criteria) I want tightened. I'll annotate and share a redline by EOD.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Operations | Redwood Inference

Thanks Ben — and thanks everyone for picking this up. A few items from Cardinal side:

- Security/compliance contact: Javier Morales (javier.morales@cardinal.ai) — I have looped procurement who will also coordinate SSO and PO routing.
- Allowlist: we will provide a short list of NATed IPs for our staging traffic by EOD Wed (Jul 29).

- For auth: token-based auth for staging is fine initially; we'll revisit mutual TLS if we move to an on-prem option.

Kickoff availability: Aug 3 09:00 PT works. We'll expect a kickoff agenda 24h in advance.
